on 16 May, 2024
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy

Writ Petition No.13417 of 2024
Order:

This Writ Petition, under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, is filed by the petitioner, seeking the following relief:
".......to issue an appropriate writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS directing the respondents to forebear from taking possession of the property bearing Municipal No.8-2-293/82/J/23-B, on Plot No.B-23, in the layout of Journalist Co-Operative Housing Society Ltd., admeasuring 295 square yards situated at Journalist Colony, Jubliee Hills, Hyderabad without taking recourse to the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 or the provision of the GHMC Act more particularly Section 145 and 146 of the Act in so far as the petitioner is concerned and pass such other order or orders.....".

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Heard Ms. Divya Rai and Mr. Swaroop Sai, learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Municipal Administration and Urban Development for respondent No.1,
Sri K. Sidhartha Rao, learned Standing counsel for the respondent No.2 and perused the record.
3.

The petitioner claims to be the absolute owner and possessor of the house property bearing Municipal No.8-2-293/82/J/23-B, in Block No.23, Journalist Co-operative Housing Society admeasuring 295 square yards situated at Journalist Colony, Jubliee Hills, Hyderabad, having purchased the same through registered sale deed bearing document No.3126 of 2008, dated 12.08.2008.

The further case of the petitioner is that he has applied for permission for construction of Stilt +3 Upper Floors and the same was granted by the 2nd respondent vide Permit No.12646/DC/CZ/Cir-10/2012, dated 03.07.2012.
It is further case of the petitioner that he had constructed the house strictly in accordance with the sanctioned plan.

While the matter stood thus,
the respondent have notified the road from Agrasen Junction to Jubilee Hills Check Post as 120 feet in R.D.P. approved in proceeding No.830121/TPS/HO/TW/GHMC/2020, dated 07.01.2021.

It is the further case of the petitioner that the 2nd respondent has taken up the development of Road from Virinchi Hospital to Agrasen Junction via Road No.12 and 120-00"
proposed Road from Agrasen Junction to Jubilee Hills Check Post via KBR Park.

The grievance of the petitioner is that the 2nd respondent without issuing any notice and without conducting any enquiry, marked the portion of the land of the petitioner for the purpose of road widening that too without following the procedure contemplated under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 Act.

sentences.text:
5. Sri K. Sidhartha Rao, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the 2nd respondent,
on instructions, would submit that for the purpose of widening of the road as per the Master Plan, a survey work has been undertaken by the respondent-Corporation and if the petitioner's land is effected in the proposed road widening as per the Master Plan, the respondent-Corporation will follow due process of law for acquiring the land.

6. In view of the above submissions, this Court, deems it appropriate to dispose of this Writ Petition directing the 2nd respondent to follow the procedure as contemplated in law, if the petitioner's land is required for the purpose of widening of road as per Master Plan i.e., 100-00" Master Plan Road from Virinchi Hospital to Agrasen Junction via Road No.12 and 120-00"
proposed Road from Agrasen Junction to Jubilee Hills Check Post via KBR Park i.e., after issuing notice to all the concerned and after conducting enquiry.

Till such exercise is completed, the respondents are directed not to interfere or dispossess the petitioner from his house bearing Municipal No.8-2-293/82/J/23- B, in Block No.23, Journalist Co-operative Housing Society admeasuring 295 square yards situated at Journalist Colony, Jubliee Hills, Hyderabad.
7. With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
8. As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

JUSTICE C.V.BHASKAR REDDY Date: 16-05-2024 vrks M/S. Classic Trades Private Limited vs The State Of Telangana on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57347792/
